claimBoundary: This ruleset is not an OpenAI schema or portal result. A passing report cannot replace bundle upload, the OpenAI skill safety/security scan, review, runtime, or publication evidence. Scan Tools remains an MCP-specific external gate.

localConservativeChecks.assetDecoder: SVG only until a bounded, vulnerability-reviewed raster decoder is pinned
localConservativeChecks.promptNormalization: NFC plus Unicode whitespace collapse for duplicate detection; the portal algorithm is not published
localConservativeChecks.symlinks: Rejected by the Starlight package evidence boundary even where the portal may warn or ignore
localConservativeChecks.skillsOnlyScreenshots: Blocked on skills-only ZIP archives per live submission error screenshot_configuration_excluded; With MCP submissions permit UI starter-prompt screenshots
localConservativeChecks.skillMetadataBounds: Short description 25-64 chars and MCP tool dependency value/description 128/256 chars are local conservative checks; upstream documents 1,024-char skill description and 64-char combined identity
